BmsChanDescriptor.description: 16-byte descriptor passed to bms_chan_bind with a TP session channel array. The bind check needs words 0 and 3 to be nonzero. Other fields are not established.

fields.name: word0
fields.description: Must be nonzero for bms_chan_bind to succeed. Meaning not established; probably a configuration or capability word of the channel.

fields.name: word3
fields.description: Second word checked by bms_chan_bind; must be nonzero. Meaning not established.

BmsMeasRecord.description: Measurement and cell record at 0x20000BDC, reached through a base pointer. Only the fields used by the functions in this packet are listed. The size is the smallest extent that holds those fields, not a confirmed end.

fields.name: cell_count
fields.description: Number of cells to read. bms_4168_0800c80c uses it as the loop bound of the cell scan, which reads at most 16 cells.

fields.name: filtered_avg
fields.description: Copy of the low half of the filtered cell average (0x20000DEC). bms_4168_0800c80c sets it to 0 when a scan reports a fault.

fields.name: meas
fields.description: Signed 16-bit measurement compared by protection debounce in bms_4168_0800c380. Unit not established.

fields.name: flags_124
fields.description: Status flags. Bits 1, 4 and 11 are tested by bms_4168_0800be58 and bit 13 is set by bms_4168_0800c380 when its debounce expires. Probably a protection and status latch word.

fields.name: balance_mask
fields.description: Balance bit mask over up to 16 cells (bit i is cell i). It is stored as two u16 halves at 0x13C and 0x13E, written and read back by bms_4168_0800be58.

fields.name: cell_mv
fields.description: Cell voltage readings, one u16 per cell in address order. Written by bms_4168_0800c80c and used by the balance logic. Unit not established.

fields.name: state_194
fields.description: Status word. Bit 9 (0x200) is set when the balance period has elapsed and cleared when balancing is released in bms_4168_0800be58. Bit 6 is tested by bms_ctrl_request_handshake.

fields.name: temp_sel
fields.description: Temperature chosen for protection by bms_4168_0800c6dc: the minimum when the midpoint (bms_temp_midpoint) is below 20, otherwise the maximum.
